query: Please implement an onboarding form management application for creating and managing onboarding forms. The application should have functionalities for form creation, bulk sending, and data management. Administrators should be able to create forms, send them in bulk to contract employees, and efficiently manage collected data. The application should also have role-based access control, ensure data encryption, and have the ability to view, search, sort, filter, and manage collected employee information. Set the background to pale ash, and apply slate gray to components.
